source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 20 September 1946, p. 3 ("Nominations for County and Rural Councils")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name checked against the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Election of the county council, 1946, the first after the wartime postponement of the 1942 and 1945 elections: nominations received by W. Jenkinson, returning officer, 19 September 1946; contests in Armagh and Lurgan, polled 3 October 1946. The Belfast News-Letter prints no party labels, so none are given for the unopposed members. Hawthorne, Richardson, McCreesh and Mrs. Greeves were new members. Returned unopposed.
